brief_rationale: The model met all 8 responsibility-chain items without serious error, completing medication reconciliation, red-flag screening, safety boundaries, and a concrete handoff plan. One high-order point (HO4) was completed through tailored navigation of the family's practical barriers. However, no second high-order point was validly completed—HO1 correction lacked family teach-back, HO2 did not surface a hidden execution failure beyond initial uncertainty, and HO3 verification did not yield a verification judgment beyond using workspace records. Without two completed high-order points, the trajectory cannot reach grade 5.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides interim monitoring thresholds, clarifies when to message vs. seek emergency care, and confirms the planned follow-up. The episode ends with shared understanding of unresolved items (ongoing fatigue, medication reconciliation pending final in-person review).
